```{r}
# Muhamad Aqsal Zulhaj Adha
# 222413664 / 2KS3

# 1. LOAD LIBRARY
library(readxl)
library(urca)
library(lmtest)

# 2. PERSIAPAN DATA
data <- read_excel("D:/POLSTAT STIS/TINGKAT II/Sem 4/ARW/Data No 3.xlsx")

colnames(data)[3] <- "Konsumsi"
colnames(data)[4] <- "PDB"

ts_konsumsi <- ts(data$Konsumsi, start = c(2010, 1), frequency = 4)
ts_pdb <- ts(data$PDB, start = c(2010, 1), frequency = 4)

plot(cbind(ts_konsumsi, ts_pdb), main="Tren Konsumsi RT dan PDB Indonesia")

# 3. UJI STASIONERITAS
# Data asli
summary(ur.df(ts_konsumsi, type = "none", lags = 1))
summary(ur.df(ts_pdb, type = "none", lags = 1))

# First Differencing
dkonsumsi <- diff(ts_konsumsi)
dpdb <- diff(ts_pdb)

summary(ur.df(dkonsumsi, type = "none", lags = 1))
summary(ur.df(dpdb, type = "none", lags = 1))

# 4. REGRESI JANGKA PANJANG & UJI KOINTEGRASI (ENGLE-GRANGER)
model_jp <- lm(ts_konsumsi ~ ts_pdb)
print(summary(model_jp))

resid_jp <- residuals(model_jp)

# Uji stasioneritas pada residual
uji_kointegrasi <- ur.df(resid_jp, type = "none", lags = 1)
print(summary(uji_kointegrasi))

# 5. ESTIMASI ERROR CORRECTION MODEL (ECM)
ect_1 <- resid_jp[1:(length(resid_jp) - 1)]

# Regresi ECM
model_ecm <- lm(dkonsumsi ~ dpdb + ect_1)
print(summary(model_ecm))

# 6. UJI DIAGNOSTIK RESIDUAL ECM (ASUMSI KLASIK)

# A. Uji Autokorelasi (Breusch-Godfrey Test)
print(bgtest(model_ecm))

# B. Uji Heteroskedastisitas (Breusch-Pagan Test)
print(bptest(model_ecm))
```
